question: Which sites complete the field octad and what is the corresponding sub-field octad?
premises: Vārāṇasī, Kāliṅga, Kulūtā, and likewise Lāhulā complete the list of fields.
The teachers declare an octad of sub-fields.
The sub-field octad corresponds to the eight front petals of the heart-lotus.
inference: The field octad is completed by Vārāṇasī, Kāliṅga, Kulūtā, and Lāhulā, while a parallel sub-field octad is mapped to the front petals of the heart-lotus.
uncertainties: The term 'front petals' (agradala) may indicate petal tips or a specific petal subset; the exact anatomical mapping is unclear.
plain_english: And Vārāṇasī, Kāliṅga, Kulūtā, and likewise Lāhulā: they declare this as the octad of sub-fields, corresponding to the eight front petals of the heart-lotus.
